claim: The historical screens (sp_battle2_scenario, main_panel Initialise("historic", prefs, <all>), SetupBattle -> sp_battle3_scenario StartBattle) start a historical battle from autostart. FrontEnd.EnumerateBattleMaps("historic", false) returns 0 maps on this PC (the main menu button makes the same call: the single-player NHB_ battles are not listed, cause open), ("historic", true) returns 15 NHMPB_ battles; presets with all_maps=1 load NHMPB_Dresden_3v3 (terrain hb_dresden) and NHMPB_Nile_1v1 (hb_nile). A historical setup File ends in an .xml (dresden_battle.xml in folder dresden_3v3) whose terrain folder differs: the preset names terrain=. A warm reset out of a historical battle stops after closing mp_postbattle and ctl stops answering: leave it by a relaunch (ctl.py scene does)
